import unittest

from solution import make_grid


class MakeGridTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_shape_and_scalar_fill(self):
        grid = make_grid(2, 3, 7)
        self.assertEqual(grid, [[7, 7, 7], [7, 7, 7]])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0], grid[1])

    def test_every_cell_is_an_independent_deep_copy(self):
        fill = {"items": [[1], {"value": 2}]}
        grid = make_grid(2, 2, fill)
        self.assertEqual(grid, [[fill, fill], [fill, fill]])
        for row in grid:
            for cell in row:
                self.assertIsNot(cell, fill)
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0][0], grid[0][1])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0][0], grid[1][0])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0][0]["items"], grid[0][1]["items"])

        grid[0][0]["items"][0].append(99)
        grid[0][0]["items"][1]["value"] = 100
        self.assertEqual(grid[0][1], fill)
        self.assertEqual(grid[1][0], fill)
        self.assertEqual(grid[1][1], fill)
        self.assertEqual(fill, {"items": [[1], {"value": 2}]})

    def test_mutating_original_after_creation_does_not_change_cells(self):
        fill = [1, {"nested": [2]}]
        grid = make_grid(1, 2, fill)
        fill.append(3)
        fill[1]["nested"].append(4)
        self.assertEqual(grid, [[[1, {"nested": [2]}], [1, {"nested": [2]}]]])

    def test_zero_dimensions_have_natural_shapes(self):
        self.assertEqual(make_grid(0, 3, []), [])
        grid = make_grid(3, 0, [])
        self.assertEqual(grid, [[], [], []])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[0], grid[1])
        self.assertIsNot(grid[1], grid[2])
        self.assertEqual(make_grid(0, 0, object()), [])

    def test_invalid_dimension_types(self):
        invalid = (True, False, 1.0, "2", None)
        for value in invalid:
            with self.subTest(dimension="rows", value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    make_grid(value, 1, None)
            with self.subTest(dimension="columns", value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                    make_grid(1, value, None)

    def test_negative_dimensions(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            make_grid(-1, 2, None)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            make_grid(2, -1, None)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
